iteration_summaries.hypothesis: The system has a modular multiplicative causal structure with 4 distinct output modules. Y3 depends ONLY on X1 (+) and X3 (+), with all other inputs having exactly zero effect. Y4 depends on X2 (+, strong), X4 (+, moderate), X6 (-, moderate), and X1 (very weak +), with X3 and X5 having zero effect. Y2 depends on X2 (+, primary driver), X4 (+), X1 (-), X3 (-), and X6 (complex: sign flips from positive at low X2 to negative at high X2), with X5 having zero effect. Y1 depends on all 6 inputs (all positive) with strong multiplicative interactions: X2 is the primary driver, X4 amplifies strongly at high X2 (X2*X4 interaction), X6 has a convex accelerating effect especially at high X2 (X2*X6 interaction), X5 saturates around 0.5, and X1/X3 are weak positive. The Pareto front is primarily parameterized by X2 (trades Y1/Y4 vs Y2) and secondarily by X6 (at high X2, trades Y1/Y2 improvement vs Y4 reduction). Universally optimal settings are X1=1, X3=1, X4=1, X5≥0.5.
new_findings: All 10 final optimization points joined the Pareto front, confirming the causal model's accuracy (prediction errors consistently <1%)
Pushing X6 to 1.0 at X2=1 achieved new Y1 record of 1.132 with Y2=0.303, confirming the convex acceleration of X6's effect on Y1
The 3D Pareto surface was successfully filled with intermediate X6 points at high X2, with 5 new surface points all non-dominated
Main X6=0.1 line gaps at X2=0.2, 0.7, 0.85, 0.95 were filled, completing dense coverage of the primary trade-off axis
Final Pareto front has 21 points spanning Y1=[0.049,1.132], Y2=[0.071,0.362], Y4=[0.036,0.322] with HV improvement from 0.258 to ~0.28
surprises: The X6 effect on Y1 at X2=1 was larger going from X6=0.1 to 0.4 at X2=0.8 (ΔY1≈0.054) than at X2=1.0 (ΔY1≈0.023), suggesting the X2*X6 interaction is more complex than simple multiplication
X6's convex acceleration on Y1 (rate increases from 0.077/unit at low X6 to 0.310/unit at high X6) was stronger than expected from linear gradient extrapolation
The sensitivity_report tool returned identical values for all inputs, providing no useful information despite the clear modular structure
